summary.en: Build labeled Series and DataFrames, read CSV data and answer questions with filters, grouped totals and descriptive statistics.
summary.bn: pandas দিয়ে লেবেলসহ টেবিল বানাও, CSV পড়ো আর ফিল্টার ও গ্রুপ করে ডেটার হিসাব বের করো।

notes: The Python syntax works on 3.10 and later; optional library releases have their own interpreter requirements.

sections.title: Construct columns and select with intent
Read, select and summarize real columns
Read describe as several separate measurements
Keep labels and unknown values visible
Use stable operations across supported releases
Keep the labels attached to the question

examples.title: Align a Series by its labels
examples.explanationHtml: Series arithmetic matches labels, even when their order differs. The label order is selected explicitly before printing.

examples.title: Filter a labeled marks table
examples.explanationHtml: loc combines a boolean row condition with named columns. Only the two marks reaching forty are displayed.

examples.title: Read a real UTF-8 CSV file
examples.explanationHtml: The program creates a temporary CSV and reads it with explicit column types. The leading zero remains part of each roll label.

examples.title: Combine expenses by category
examples.explanationHtml: groupby gathers matching category labels, then sum reduces each group. Sorting makes the category order deliberate.

examples.title: Describe known marks without guessing missing values
examples.explanationHtml: describe counts three known marks, and its standard deviation uses the sample definition. The missing mark is counted separately.

practice.title: Select rolls meeting a cutoff
practice.statementHtml: Read n from 0–100 and a cutoff from 0–100 on the first line. Then read n lines of distinct positive integer roll and integer mark from 0–100. Print rolls reaching the cutoff in increasing order, or NONE.
hints: Give an empty DataFrame explicit columns before filtering.

practice.title: Total category rows
practice.statementHtml: Read n from 0–100, then n lines of a lowercase ASCII category token and an integer taka amount from 0–10000. Print category and total with two decimals, sorted by category; print EMPTY if there are no rows.
hints: Convert the amount column deliberately before grouping.

practice.title: Read CSV roll labels
practice.statementHtml: Read CSV text until EOF, with header roll,mark and zero or more rows. roll is a three-digit label; mark is an integer from 0–100. Print labels with mark at least 40, preserving file order, one per line; print NONE when no labels qualify.
hints: Pass sys.stdin to read_csv and preserve roll with dtype="string".

practice.title: Summarize observed marks only
practice.statementHtml: Read one line of 0–100 integer marks or NA tokens, possibly blank. Print the number of known and missing marks. On a second line print the known mean with two decimals, or NA if none are known.
hints: Represent NA with a missing floating value, then guard the empty-known case.

quiz.prompt: Which values result when reversed Series labels are aligned?
quiz.explanation: Addition matches a with a and b with b, rather than pairing positions.

quiz.prompt: How many marks does describe count when one entry is missing?
quiz.explanation: The count statistic excludes missing entries.

quiz.prompt: What total does the food group contain after aggregation?
quiz.explanation: Only rows labeled food contribute to that group.

quiz.prompt: Which pandas object represents a labeled one-dimensional collection?
quiz.explanation: A Series has values and an index; a DataFrame combines labeled columns.

quiz.prompt: Which selection uses integer position regardless of row labels?
quiz.explanation: iloc uses positions, while loc uses labels.

quiz.prompt: How can CSV reading preserve a roll label such as 007?
options: Give that column a string dtype
quiz.explanation: Numeric inference would discard the meaningful leading zeros.

quiz.prompt: Which filter selects marks from 40 through 80 inclusively?
quiz.explanation: Parenthesized comparisons combine entry by entry using &.

quiz.prompt: Which action makes a missing mark visibly different from a zero mark?
options: Replace every missing mark with zero silently
Count isna separately from known values
quiz.explanation: Missing means unknown; zero is a known observed value.

quiz.prompt: Which standard deviation does numeric Series.describe use by default?
quiz.explanation: The sample calculation divides squared deviations by n minus one.

quiz.prompt: How should a subset be changed when the original DataFrame must stay independent?
options: Create an explicit copy before assigning
quiz.explanation: Explicit copying and direct loc assignments avoid ambiguous mutation expectations.

quiz.prompt: What happens to missing group keys in ordinary groupby by default?
options: They always form a zero group
Their rows are excluded from groups
They are converted to empty strings
quiz.explanation: Use dropna=False when missing keys must remain a group.

quiz.prompt: Why select summary statistics individually before printing?
options: It makes missing values valid marks
Their labels and decimal formatting stay deliberate
quiz.explanation: A whole table representation can vary with display settings and library versions.

keyPoints.en: A Series carries labels, and a DataFrame organizes labeled columns.
keyPoints.bn: Series-এ লেবেলসহ মান থাকে, আর DataFrame-এ কলাম ধরে টেবিল সাজাও।

keyPoints.en: Series arithmetic aligns labels rather than positions.
keyPoints.bn: Series-এর হিসাবে একই লেবেলের মান মেলে, শুধু একই পজিশনের মান নয়।

keyPoints.en: loc selects labels; iloc selects integer positions.
keyPoints.bn: লেবেল দিয়ে নিতে loc আর পজিশন দিয়ে নিতে iloc ব্যবহার করো।

keyPoints.en: CSV types need deliberate choices when labels contain leading zeros.
keyPoints.bn: রোল নম্বরের শুরুর শূন্য রাখতে CSV পড়ার সময় স্ট্রিং টাইপ দাও।

keyPoints.en: Missing marks should be counted separately from known zero marks.
keyPoints.bn: না পাওয়া মার্ক আর শূন্য মার্ক এক কথা নয়, তাই আলাদা করে গুনো।

keyPoints.en: Grouped reductions answer one question per category.
keyPoints.bn: ক্যাটাগরি ধরে গ্রুপ করলে প্রতিটা ক্যাটাগরির আলাদা হিসাব পাবে।

examQuestions.question: Compare loc and iloc when a table has row labels 10, 20 and 30.
examQuestions.answerHtml: df.loc[20] selects the row labeled 20. df.iloc[1] selects the second row, which has label 20 here. df.loc[1] raises KeyError because label 1 is absent. Positional and label slicing also differ in stop handling.

examQuestions.question: For marks 40, 60, 80 and one missing value, find count, mean and sample standard deviation.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Count is 3 and mean is 60. Squared deviations total 800. Sample variance is 800/(3-1)=400, so standard deviation is 20. The missing entry is excluded, rather than treated as zero.

examQuestions.question: Design a CSV summary that preserves roll labels and does not hide missing marks.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Specify roll as a string column during read_csv. Validate the required columns and mark domain. Count missing marks explicitly, calculate known-value summaries, and state their denominator. Select output columns and row order deliberately. Do not replace absent marks with zero without an agreed policy.
